# JamesTech LLC

> AI automation consulting and Microsoft Power Platform builds for 5 to 200 person firms in and around Columbia, Maryland.

JamesTech LLC installs an AI Operating System for small businesses: the context, data, automations, and agents that let AI do recurring work inside the Microsoft 365 and Power Platform tools a firm already owns. Engagements start with an AI Opportunity Review, continue with a scoped build, and can extend to a Fractional AI Officer retainer or a half-day AI Operating System training class. Founder Mark Lucas has built on the Microsoft stack for roughly thirty years, including three years as a Microsoft employee, and is an Artemis program contractor at NASA via The Aerospace Corporation.

## Core Topics

- AI operating system for small business (what it is, how it is installed)
- Fractional AI Officer retainers (Maryland)
- AI training for small business owners (Columbia, MD, half-day class)
- AI automation consulting (Columbia, Maryland)
- Power Automate and Power Platform consulting (Maryland)

## Key Pages

- [AI Operating System for Small Business](https://jamestech.com/ai-operating-system.html): What it is, the five layers, what it costs, how JamesTech installs one in three steps.
- [Fractional AI Officer for Maryland Firms](https://jamestech.com/fractional-ai-officer.html): Part-time ownership of AI strategy, governance, and rollout; retainers from $3,700 a month.
- [AI Operating System Training Class, Columbia MD](https://jamestech.com/ai-training-columbia-md.html): Half-day, in-person, six seats; leave with a working system.
- [AI Opportunity Review](https://jamestech.com/): From $2,500, credited toward the build. Leave with 3 to 5 quantified automation opportunities ranked by hours and dollars returned.
- [AI Operating System Training Class](https://jamestech.com/ai-training.html): Half-day, in-person class in Columbia, MD for owners and practice leaders of 5 to 200 person firms. Walk out with a working AI Operating System, not notes.
- [Case Study: Coaching That Ends With the Work Automated](https://jamestech.com/case-study.html): A global financial-services team went from stalled vendor training to building their own automations; one 40-hour task now runs in minutes.
- [Privacy Policy](https://jamestech.com/privacy.html)
- [Terms and Messaging](https://jamestech.com/terms.html)

## About

Mark Lucas, founder of JamesTech LLC (owned since 2001), Columbia, Maryland. Microsoft certified. Has delivered for NASA's Artemis program, the Department of Justice, NATO, and a global financial-services firm. Builds on Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, and SharePoint daily.
